eyebrow: Capstone scenario: 50 logical qubits at distance 21
code:
Step 1: per-logical-qubit cost = 2d^2 - 1 = 2(441) - 1 = 881 qubits
Step 2: total = 50 x 881 = 44,050 physical qubits (base code only)
Step 3: this all requires the hardware's error rate below p_th
Step 4: 44,050 qubits (before distillation) is far beyond NISQ hardware today
caption: Theory says scaling up is worth it; the arithmetic says exactly what it costs; honest assessment says hardware isn't there yet — all three, at once.
